$comment: D7 activity_leave pending-cancel: cancels only the SAME connection's still-pending join attempt or its resulting unchanged lease, with a bounded tombstone. Delayed cancel cannot release a newer lease or another attempt. Local load-before-join cancellation sends nothing.
name: leave-cancel-pending
invariants: cancel travels on the original channel connection; a reconnect cannot cancel a pending attempt from a dead connection
if the join already completed, cancel only succeeds when the resulting lease is unchanged; a rotated lease (reconnect, duplicate transfer, offer rotation) is never released
cancels are remembered for cancelTombstoneSeconds to make duplicate cancels idempotent
a cancelled pending join never seated a rider and produces no roster change beyond removal
